name: b2b_saas
archetype: Niche B2B SaaS for supply chain analytics
market: Enterprise procurement and operations teams, Fortune 1000, $500-5000/month
density: Clean enterprise software style. Hero is a 2-column split: left has headline + CTA, right has a product dashboard mockup. Dashboard mockup layout: 180px left sidebar nav (dark #1E3A5F), center panel with two stacked line charts (demand forecast + inventory levels), right panel with 3 KPI cards (cost savings, fill rate, cycle time). Marketing copy sections use 3-column feature grids with generous 48px section padding. ROI calculator is a prominent 2-column widget: left inputs (current spend, team size, order volume), right shows calculated annual savings in large display type.
nav_style: White sticky nav. Logo left. Nav center: Platform, Solutions, Integrations, Pricing, Resources. Right: 'Log in' ghost button and 'Request demo' filled button in slate blue (#1E3A5F). Customer name marquee ticker scrolls below the nav in a thin light-grey strip.
commercial_model: Enterprise SaaS with annual contracts. No self-serve — everything routes to 'Request demo'. Pricing page shows tiers conceptually without exact numbers. ROI calculator is primary lead gen tool. Case studies and analyst reports gated behind email.
color_palette: Professional slate blue (#1E3A5F) as primary. White (#FFFFFF) and very light grey (#F8FAFC) for page backgrounds. Warm accent orange (#F97316) for CTAs and highlights. Chart categorical palette (6 colors): #4F6BFF (blue), #F97316 (orange), #22C55E (green), #EF4444 (red), #A78BFA (purple), #06B6D4 (teal). Table row alternation: white / #F8FAFC. Success green #22C55E for upward metrics. Trustworthy, data-professional aesthetic.
typography: Inter throughout (Google Fonts). Chart axis labels and numbers in Inter Tabular Lining numeric variant. Body at 16px. Stat callouts (ROI metrics) in 48px bold slate blue with 14px label below. Customer testimonial quotes in 20px italic #4A5568. Table headers in 12px uppercase with 0.08em letter-spacing. Product UI mockup uses the same Inter stack at smaller sizes (12-14px).

pages.title: Home
pages.description: 2-column hero: left has headline ('Cut Supply Chain Costs by 23%'), subheadline, 'Request Demo' CTA, and 3 micro-stats (avg savings, NPS, uptime). Right shows full product dashboard mockup (sidebar nav + 2 stacked charts + 3 KPI cards). Customer logo strip (8 Fortune 500 logos). 3-column feature grid (Demand Sensing, Inventory Optimization, Supplier Risk). ROI statistics section with 3 large numbers. Customer testimonial quote. Integration logos wall (50+ partner logos). Footer CTA.

pages.title: Platform
pages.description: Product features with 4 tabs: Demand Forecasting, Inventory Optimization, Supplier Analytics, Reporting & Alerts. Each tab: full-width product screenshot mockup on dark background, 3 bullet points of capabilities, 1 customer quote. Data security and compliance section: SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, data residency options.

pages.title: Solutions by Industry
pages.description: 4 industry verticals as tabs or grid: Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, CPG. Each: specific pain point headline, 3 use cases, 1 customer logo + quote + result metric. Company size navigation: Mid-Market (50-500 employees) vs Enterprise (500+).

pages.title: Pricing
pages.description: 3 tier cards: Starter (up to 5 users), Growth (up to 25 users, most popular badge), Enterprise (unlimited, contact sales). Feature comparison checklist. Annual/monthly toggle showing 20% annual discount. ROI calculator widget below pricing cards. Implementation timeline table: Week 1-2 onboarding, Week 3-4 data integration, Week 5-6 go-live.

pages.title: Resources
pages.description: Resource hub with tabs: Case Studies, White Papers, Webinars, Blog. Featured Gartner report download card with analyst quote. 3 upcoming webinar cards with date, topic, speaker photo, registration CTA. 4 blog article cards with category tags (Inventory, Procurement, Technology, Industry). Video demo library with 5 thumbnail cards.
